translation: Ele ⟨disse⟩ e ⟨veio⟩ ⟨את⟩ insetos ⟨e⟩ piolhos em ⟨a⟩ fronteira ⟨deles⟩

tokens.rationale: אמר - to say (used with great latitude)
ויבא - vav-consecutive imperfect of בוא (to come); requires 'e' in Portuguese sequence
ערב - 'swarm' (here specifically mosquitoes/flies); translated generically as 'insetos' to include gnats
כנים - 'gnats' (small flying insects); 'piolhos' captures the infestation context
בכל - 'in all'; requires article in Portuguese
